#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    int stringLen;
    std::string text;
    std::cin >> stringLen >> text;

    int outMax = 0;
    int inMax = 0;
    int count = 0;
    int i = 0;

    while (i < (int)text.length()) {
        if (text[i] == '(') {
            while (i < (int)text.length() && text[i] != ')') {
                int c = 0;
                while (i < (int)text.length() && text[i] != '_'
                        && text[i] != ')' && text[i] != '(') {
                    if (c == 0) {
                        inMax++;
                        c++;
                    }
                    i++;
                }
                if (i < (int)text.length() && text[i] != ')') {
                    i++;
                }
            }
            if (i < (int)text.length()) {
                i++;
            }
            count = 0;
        } else {
            bool enteredInside = false;
            while (!enteredInside && i < (int)text.length()) {
                while (i < (int)text.length() && text[i] != '_'
                        && text[i] != ')' && text[i] != '(') {
                    count++;
                    i++;
                }
                if (count > outMax) {
                    outMax = count;
                }
                if (i < (int)text.length() && text[i] == '(') {
                    enteredInside = true;
                    count = 0;
                } else if (i < (int)text.length()) {
                    count = 0;
                    i++;
                } else {
                    count = 0;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (outMax < count) {
        outMax = count;
    }
    std::cout << outMax << " " << inMax << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
